verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Firecrawl can crawl an entire website and discover all URLs (firecrawl-gh-3, firecrawl-gh-4), which implies a crawl feature suitable for a data-engineer's bulk scraping needs, but nothing in the pack explicitly documents a breadth-first crawl strategy or a configurable maximum page limit parameter. Missing for 10: explicit mention of BFS traversal mode, documented maxPages/limit parameter, and independent confirmation that these controls work at scale.
